name: Harridan's Lair
summary: Harridan's Lair is a cave in eastern Greenshade, northwest of Marbruk containing senche-tigers. The pride that lives in the cave is led by the matriarch, Razorclaw. Torchbugs and an unusually high amount of frogs are found in numbers within.
notes: The Letter from Bashshi-ra, found in Woodhearth, marks this location on your map.
In order to get the achievement, you not only have to kill Razorclaw, but the two Senche-Tigers accompanying her.
